name: The Chase: Celebrity Special
description: Celebrity series of The Chase. Contestants must pit their wits against the Chaser, a ruthless quiz genius determined to stop them winning the cash prize.

Christmas Special (1): Harry Judd, Angela Griffin, Kai Widdrington & Shane Richie
videos.overview: Bradley Walsh hosts as McFly's Harry Judd, actress Angela Griffin, dancer Kai Widdrington and actor and comedian Shane Richie take on one of Britain's finest quizzing brains, hoping to win money for their chosen charities. They must work as a team and play strategically to answer general knowledge questions against the clock and race down the game board to the exit without being caught.

videos.title: Christmas Special (2): Kerry Godliman, Alexander Armstrong, Bryony Page & Tony Maudsley
videos.overview: Bradley Walsh presents as actress Kerry Godliman, Pointless presenter Alexander Armstrong, Olympic trampoline champion Bryony Page and actor Tony Maudsley take on one of Britain's finest quizzing brains, hoping to win money for their chosen charities. They must work as a team and play strategically to answer general knowledge questions against the clock and race down the game board to the exit without being caught.

videos.overview: Bradley Walsh presents as comedian Lucy Porter, radio and TV presenter Colin Murray, Strictly vocalist Tommy Blaize and actor Asim Chaudhry face five Chasers.
